meta.title: MedHub, the health information system that never stops
meta.description: Patient records, consultation, cashier, pharmacy and laboratory for health facilities, even without a connection.

hero.badge: Built for the DRC, in French and English
hero.subtitle: Front desk, consultation, cashier, pharmacy and laboratory on a single platform. Every workstation keeps working without a network and syncs as soon as the connection returns.

pillars.title: A tool designed for the field
pillars.subtitle: Unstable power, intermittent network, mixed hardware: MedHub is built for these conditions from day one.

offline.title: Always available
offline.text: Registration, consultation, cashier and dispensing work without a connection. Nothing is lost, nothing is typed twice.

record.title: Longitudinal record
record.text: Allergies, history, medications and vital signs on a single screen at every consultation.

finance.title: Secured revenue
finance.text: Immutable invoices and cash movements, amounts in USD and CDF, discrepancies detected the same day.

config.title: Configurable without code
config.text: Roles, prices, contracts, forms and printed documents are set in the interface.

facts.currencies: currencies handled natively: USD and CDF
facts.isolation: facilities isolated by the database itself

modules.title: One platform for the whole facility
modules.subtitle: Enable the modules you need, from the neighbourhood pharmacy to the multi-site hospital.

patients.title: Front desk and patient record
patients.text: Typo-tolerant search, quick registration in under a minute, duplicate detection and a patient card with QR code.

clinical.title: Consultation and prescribing
clinical.text: Triage, vital signs with plausibility checks, signed notes, coded diagnoses and prescribing with alerts.

billing.title: Billing and cashier
billing.text: Basket fed by the acts performed, patient and third-party shares, multi-currency payments and cash closing.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy and stock
pharmacy.text: Dispensing linked to prescriptions, stock computed from movements, lots and expiry dates tracked.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.text: Orders, specimen collection, result entry and validation, critical values flagged immediately.

integrated.title: Integrated patient record
integrated.text: Information entered once feeds the invoice, the stock and the reports.

workflows.title: Configurable workflows
workflows.text: Each facility sets its roles, prices and forms without development.

billing.title: Stock and billing linked
billing.text: Dispensing takes the stock out and adds the invoice line automatically.

security.title: Security and traceability
security.text: Hash-chained audit log, traced emergency access, encrypted data on every workstation.

hosting.title: Realistic hosting
hosting.text: Runs on standard cPanel hosting and moves to a dedicated server without a rewrite.

pricing.title: Simple, predictable pricing
pricing.subtitle: No upfront investment, a monthly subscription sized to your facility.
pricing.disclaimer: Indicative values in US dollars, confirmed at subscription. Congolese franc equivalent at the daily rate.

cta.title: Ready to get your facility running?
cta.subtitle: A health post can be operational in less than five working days.

footer.tagline: Local-first health information system for health facilities.

configuration.title: Devices and security
configuration.subtitle: Settings applied to every device of the structure, published by version.
configuration.lifecycle: Every change goes through a draft, then a publication. A published version is never changed: the previous one is archived and can be restored. Devices receive the published values at their next sync.

offline_token_days.title: Offline access
offline_token_days.text: How long a device may work without syncing (1 to 30 days). After that, an online sign-in is required; nothing is lost.

auto_lock_minutes.title: Auto-lock
auto_lock_minutes.text: Inactivity delay before the device asks for the PIN (1 to 60 minutes).

pin_max_attempts.title: PIN attempts
pin_max_attempts.text: Attempts before blocking (3 to 20). Data is only erased when no operation is waiting to be sent.

step_up_minutes.title: Confirmation of sensitive changes
step_up_minutes.text: How long the last proof of the second factor stays valid before a configuration change (5 to 60 minutes).

password_min_length.title: Minimum password length
password_min_length.text: Minimum number of characters (10 to 64). No composition rule is imposed: a phrase of several words is recommended.

duplicate_alert_score.title: Duplicate alert at registration
duplicate_alert_score.text: Similarity score from which the device shows similar patients before creating a new one (30 to 100).

duplicate_candidate_score.title: Merge candidate
duplicate_candidate_score.text: Score from which the server lists two records in the duplicates queue (30 to 120).

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Facility accounts, roles, assignments and resets.

actions.disableHint: Their sessions end at once; each of their devices loses offline access at its next sync. Nothing is deleted.
actions.enableHint: The user will be able to sign in again with their password.

roles.requiresMfaHint: Holders of this role will set up 2FA at their next sign-in.
roles.privilegedHint: This role grants administration rights (shield icon): two-factor authentication is always required.

template.same: Same as the MedHub template role.
template.differs: {count, plural, one {# difference} other {# differences}} with the MedHub template role.

sensitivity.hint: By default a role only opens normal records, unless it may mark sensitivity itself: it then opens all of them. Each level includes the previous ones.

reference.itemsHint: The code of a saved item never changes (recorded data refers to it). To remove an item, untick "Active".

training.title: Training base
training.subtitle: A practice facility next to yours: same configuration, same accounts, fictitious patients.
training.cardText: Staff practise there without touching real records.

training.codeHint: Same usernames and passwords as in the real facility.

training.archived: {count, plural, one {# previous base archived} other {# previous bases archived}}, kept but no longer accessible.
training.insideTraining: You are signed in to a training base: it cannot have a training base of its own.

how.copy: Copy of the published configuration, sites and departments, roles, pick lists and active accounts (same passwords and two-factor authentication).
how.signIn: To practise, everyone signs in with the training base code instead of the usual one.
how.banner: A "Training base" banner stays on screen at all times to avoid any confusion.
how.messages: No real SMS or email leaves it: sending is simulated.
how.reset: Resetting starts again from today's configuration; the previous base is archived, never deleted.

scope.title: Patients kept on workstations
scope.subtitle: Synchronisation scope: which records each workstation downloads and keeps offline.
scope.hint: "Whole structure" suits small structures. "Scope" keeps on the device the patients registered there, the user's favourites, patients opened from a server search and those with recent activity; the others remain reachable through the online search. A role's rule prevails over the structure's rule; when several roles have one, the widest applies.
scope.saved: Rule saved: workstations apply it at their next synchronisation.

rdv.title: Reception, queues and agendas
rdv.subtitle: Configuration shared by every workstation: devices receive it with their catalogs at their next connection.
rdv.saved: Saved. Workstations receive the new configuration at their next synchronisation.

queues.title: Waiting queues
queues.subtitle: One queue per step (reception, triage, consultation...). Tickets carry the queue prefix, the workstation code and a number of the day.

types.title: Appointment types
types.subtitle: Each type sets the duration offered when booking.

agenda.title: Agendas
agenda.subtitle: Weekly hours cut into slots, per practitioner or department, and exceptions (leave, closures, extra hours).
